title: REC-C3.3.3 (Tren B): Native probe mcp tool surface — service-port expansion
summary: Expand the chronos MCP tool surface so that AI agents can drive the native probe to investigate a target process: capture, query, extract, advance, and step. Tren B does NOT introduce new ports; it reuses existing service-port abstractions (Rule B1). It does NOT cross the chronos_store port with chronos_store DTOs (Rule B2). It does NOT own store->native direction (REC-C3.4).

constraints.B1_no_native_probe_service_port: Tren B reuses existing service-port abstractions; no NativeProbeServicePort introduced.
constraints.B2_no_dyn_any_store_dto_across_port: No dyn Any / downcast / chronos_store DTO crossing the port.
constraints.B2_session_lifecycle_only: SessionRepository stays lifecycle/registry (no inflation); Tren B introduces SessionArchive + CounterexampleRepository + moves SessionMetadata to chronos-domain.
constraints.B3_store_to_native_is_rec_c3_4: store->native direction belongs to REC-C3.4, NOT Tren B.
constraints.B4_composition_root_chronos_mcp: Composition root in chronos-mcp::composition; bootstrap-scoped vs session-scoped factory distinction is mandatory.
constraints.B5_no_ignore_no_skip: No #[ignore] and no --skip ever. Pre-existing failures get owner + cycle, not waivers.
constraints.B6_strict_replay_untouched: REC-C1.5.2 strict replay semantics stay untouched; Cycle A reconciled the test, not the production code.
constraints.B7_no_squash_no_rebase: No squash, no rebase, no merge commit; preserve full SHA chain.
constraints.B8_no_permanent_waivers: Findings are no_action_in_current_cycle, not permanent waivers.
constraints.B9_honesty_over_coverage: Comments must match what code actually verifies.

owned_by_this_cycle: expansion of native probe tool surface at chronos-mcp level
Reuse existing service-port abstractions for probe semantics
SessionArchive + CounterexampleRepository + SessionMetadata to chronos-domain (lifecycle split per B2)
out_of_scope: Production schema changes unrelated to native probe capture
